reviews.title: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE ARGB White V2 CPU Air Cooler
reviews.comment: I bought the Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE ARGB White V2 for my new white-themed PC build with an Intel Core Ultra 2 processor, and as always, Thermalright’s coolers are a cut above.  The white finish is sleek and matches my build perfectly, adding a clean, stylish vibe. The six heat pipes with AGHP GEN 5.0 technology keep my Core Ultra 2 nice and cool, even during intense gaming sessions and multitasking. The dual 120mm PWM fans (up to 1850RPM) deliver strong airflow while staying surprisingly quiet. The ARGB lighting looks great and syncs seamlessly with my setup.  Installation was a breeze on my Intel 1851 socket, with clear instructions and solid mounting hardware (it also supports AMD AM4/AM5). The cooler’s build quality is top-tier, and for the price, it’s an absolute steal. This is why I always go back to Thermalright—reliable performance and great aesthetics. 5 stars for now, and I’ll update if anything changes with extended use. Highly recommend!
